sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Smiling woman with brown swept-up hair under a brown fedora with narrow gold band, large rounded dark-rimmed shaded glasses, brown brows and visible teeth. Mustard-gold coat with broad collar/pale piping and one large dark round button; near-front slight screen-right pose. Full dark grey painted backing and soft light; preserve cap, smile, glasses, collar and short broad neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven man in screen-left three-quarter view with tall swept brown pompadour, dark brows and serious closed mouth. Gold monocle over viewer-right visible eye with chain dropping toward collar. Burgundy lapelled suit, cream pointed buttoned shirt and cream pocket square; no tie. Full dark grey painted backing and shaded side light; preserve monocle placement and short broad collar fit.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Serious man three-quarter toward screen left with short side-parted brown hair greying at temples, heavy brows, full dark moustache and beard. Brown cigar held at mouth extends screen left with curling pale smoke. Olive-brown knitted V sweater over white pointed shirt and navy tie. Full dark grey painted backing; preserve cigar, beard, pose and compact broad neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Serious moustached man turned toward screen left, short dark hair under a light grey-beige fedora with broad brown band. Thin dark moustache, clean chin and closed frown. Dark brown trench coat with large raised/layered lapels over dark neck cloth. Full dark grey painted backing, close bust and shaded light; retain hat, small moustache only and short broad neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Man in slight screen-right three-quarter view with short brown brushed-up hair, heavy brows and long upcurled handlebar moustache, clean chin. Fine gold wire glasses over eyes. Grey-brown lapelled suit/white pointed shirt/dark brown tie, serious closed mouth. Full dark grey painted backing and soft side light; preserve moustache ends, glasses and broad short collar fit.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Bearded man slightly toward screen right, short greying dark hair beneath olive-brown fedora with dark brown band. Gold-framed aviator sunglasses, dark brows and full salt-and-pepper moustache/beard. Dark brown high-lapelled trench coat over small dark red inner top. Solemn closed mouth and full dark grey painted backing; preserve hat/glasses/beard and compact broad neck under raised collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Man in screen-right three-quarter view with high swept dark hair and short clipped sides, fine dark moustache and clean chin. Small oval dark glasses; bent brown smoking pipe held at mouth extends screen right. Dark coat with broad lapels over grey pointed buttoned shirt, no tie. Full dark grey painted backing and shaded light; preserve pipe, moustache only and short broad neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front clean-shaven sailor with dark short hair mostly covered by navy round cap bearing red star and curved gold Cyrillic lettering. Strong dark brows and restrained slightly smiling closed mouth. Navy collared tunic with round gold button, ammunition belt over viewer-left shoulder and pale strap at viewer right. Full pale grey-beige painted backing; preserve visible lettering arrangement without claiming exact tiny characters, pose/light and short broad neck.
